export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'v-p-oswal-hosiery-factory' (address GREWAL COLONY) shows 'Total Shipments 20 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2024-10-05', and a row: '2024-10-05 | V P OSWAL HOSIERY FACTORY | M/S FILS SAUVAGES 636 | WOOLEN MEN GOLVES (100% ACRYLIC) | Delhi Air, India | Toronto, Canada | 61169990 | BOL 4615674'. Same B/L 4615674 also covers 'WOOLEN WOMEN GLOVES (100% ACRYLIC)' HS 61169990 and 'WOOLEN MUFFLER (100% ACRYLIC)' HS 61171040. Ports table: 'DELHI AIR, INDIA 3' / 'TORONTO, CANADA 3'. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 20 total shipments and 1 trading partner; only 3 shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view (all dated 2024-10-05, all to the same Canadian buyer). The remaining 17 records are behind the paywall and were NOT seen.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: a real customs record with date (2024-10-05), destination (Toronto, Canada), HS codes (61169990, 61171040) and B/L number (4615674) exists, buyer M/S FILS SAUVAGES 636. Caveat on the counter: ImportKey states 20 shipments but only 3 rows were visible, so 17 records are unverified. HS discrepancy: declared HS 611691 (crocheted wool/acrylic gloves) vs actual shipped HS 61169990 (other knitted gloves, non-wool/acrylic classification) and 61171040 (knitted mufflers/scarves) — per Rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the factual 61169990 / 61171040. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is contradicted by the shipment record: the goods are knitted hosiery (acrylic gloves, mufflers), i.e. apparel/textiles, not food/FMCG. Domestic supply evidence: NOT FOUND — no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved; the web_search backend returned connection errors on every attempt and volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, so this is a genuine data gap, not a negative finding. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the free views). PAN AAMFV7594C and legal name 'V P OSWAL HOSIERY FACTORY' were not independently verified against any registry (registries out of scope for this role).
